extDescription.message: One softphone for all your tabs: calls keep going when you reload or close the CRM page.

omniboxHint.message: Type a number and press Enter to call it

popupHostUnavailable.message: The softphone could not start. Open Options to check the account.

optionsAccountHint.message: The extension runs the only softphone of this browser. Pages you allow below use it instead of starting their own.

optionsSecretsHint.message: The password is kept in memory only and forgotten when the browser closes. An approved CRM page can sign in again with a short-lived token.

optionsMicDenied.message: Microphone blocked. Allow it in the browser's site settings for this extension.

optionsAllowedOrigins.message: Pages that may use the softphone (match patterns, one per line)

optionsAllowedOriginsHint.message: For example https://crm.example.com/*. New sites ask for permission when you save.

optionsSoftphoneUrl.message: CRM page opened from the popup

optionsClickToCall.message: Call tel:, sip: and callto: links with the softphone

optionsClickToCallHint.message: On sites outside the list above this needs permission for all websites.

optionsNotifications.message: Show notifications for incoming and missed calls

approveQuestion.message: This site wants to sign the shared softphone in with its own credentials:

approveHint.message: Only allow sites you trust, such as your CRM. You can remove it later in Options.

optionsNoiseRemoval.message: AI noise removal on your microphone

optionsNoiseRemovalHint.message: Removes barking, traffic and nearby voices from what callers hear. Uses a little more CPU. The browser’s own noise filter stays on either way.

popupMicBlocked.message: The phone can’t use your microphone, so callers can’t hear you. Open Options and click “Allow microphone”.
